i.norm: Tests that a stream built from a byte array reports the whole array as available, regardless of the array's size.
Builds a stream backed by the given byte array using the builder API. No I/O conversion is needed for a byte array, so the declared {@link IOException} can never actually be thrown.
A freshly built stream should make every byte of its backing array available, whether the array is empty, has a single byte, or several.
